title: Ivyabona Bazimiye
intro: Mu bihe vya kera cane, hari umuryango uba mu gihugu c’amabarabara hagati y’inganji. Umuhanuzi wabo yarabahamagaye mu nzira y’ukuri, yamara barafatanye n’ukutemera n’agahahazo. Iyi nkuru irangira mu guhora kw’Imana. Woba ushobora kumenya iryo hanga n’iherezo ryaryo ukoresheje ibimenyetso biri aha hepfo?
clues: Hari abantu banse imburi yazanywe n’umwe mu ntumwa zabo bwite.
Intumwa yaduhamagariye gusenga Allah wenyene, iratugabisha ku bijanye n’ibiturire.
Icumuro ryacu ryari ukwanka umuhanuzi yarungitswe hagati yacu n’ubugororotsi.
Twarakekeranya ubukuru bw’iyo ntumwa, tuyirega ko ari umuhendanyi.
Igihano caradushikiye igihe twari tuba mu mihana yacu mu mutekano.
Twarasambutse kubera kwihakana umuhanuzi wacu no gutoteza abemera.
arabic: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًۭا فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرْجُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verse: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption." (29:36)
